7.2.11 Guarding condition: G_SILENT_COM_MODE_REQUESTED
[SWS_CanSM_00429] Upstream requirements: SRS_Can_01142, SRS_Can_01145
⌈The guarding condition G_SILENT_COM_MODE_REQUESTED of the CanSM_BSM state machine shall evaluate, if the latest accepted communication mode request with CanSM_RequestComMode (ref. to [SWS_CanSM_00635]) for the respective network handle of the state machine has been with the parameter ComM_Mode equal to COMM_SILENT_COMMUNICATION.⌋
